_comment: Versioned search normalization contract. Generated by scripts/generate-search-normalization.sh; do not edit by hand. Keys are hex Unicode codepoints. "unaccent" is the complete mapping applied by the server's f_unaccent (PostgreSQL unaccent.rules); "lower" is the complete per-codepoint lower() mapping that ILIKE and CITEXT use. Bare-text matching and scoring normalize as lower(unaccent(text)); tag: equality uses lower() alone. The Rust and Swift normalizers consume this file, and recipe sync fails when client and server contract versions differ.
